text:
mason: tiny poll — rain + laptop all day. recommend one playlist and one short paperback (<=180p). keep it cozy but not too sleepy. :coffee:

lee: Try Otis Redding chill/soul for warm vocals + 'The Sense of an Ending' (Barnes) if you want compact feels. :notes:

anya: For something softer: Julia Holter Loud City Song + 'The Lover' (Duras) — short & hazy. :foggy:

sophie: If you want rhythm instead of sleep: Broadcast + 'The Mezzanine' (Nicholson Baker) tiny obsessions, reads fast. :mag:

mason: nice spread. anyone do instrumental-only recs?

lee: Balmorhea or A Winged Victory for the Sullen for minimal instrumentals. pairs with essay collections too.

anya: music-bot, can you make a 12-track playlist "cozy-rain-12" mixing Otis Redding, Julia Holter, Broadcast, and 3 instrumentals? include a short link.

music-bot: Created playlist "cozy-rain-12" (12 tracks) — https://play.example/pl/cozyrain12 (expires in 7 days). Includes 3 instrumentals and suggested listening order.

sophie: votes: Otis (lee) :thumbsup:, Holter (anya) :heart:, Broadcast (sophie) :100:. Mason: pick tie-breaker snack rule?

mason: whoever brings biscuits to the kitchen meeting wins my eternal gratitude and the curated coffee tin. :cookie:

lee: i will bring biscuits. also: quick rec for a super short read — 'We Have Always Lived in the Castle' novella? (ok longer but addictive).

anya: 'The Lover' wins my vote. sophie: you reading 'The Mezzanine' aloud at 8pm?
sophie: sure, i'll do a dramatic chapter. tea & biscuits curated by lee.

music-bot: Reminder scheduled: "cozy-rain listening" at 8:00 PM today in #random.

mason: perfect. final plan: try playlist, read a snippet, biscuits & tea. see you at 8. :headphones:
